posts.title: Ruric Thar, the Unbowed
posts.description: Not Gruul? Then Die! Goal was to get the cave painting style of the brutal Gruul mtg faction, with each figure representing a notable card from the deck if I revisit this I would likely add some blood splatters/smears and some burn marks (all the practice with the Dnd Gazer can pay off!)

posts.title: The Mimeoplasm
posts.description: Another MTG commander This deck is a mishmash of shapeshifters and typal payoffs wanted to capture this with a blender cocktail mixing some of the more iconic creature types the deck contains an earlier iteration that pays homage to Amoeboid changeling (who has just the best face ever)
